title: Jobs
description: data/jobs.json: the four kinds of job a contract can be (Phase 5 C1). type: the rule sim/world/jobs.gd judges it by (clear_bandits, escort, hold, hunt); words: its name, a key in data/text/en.json; party: the WorldParty type it puts on the map (data/balance/world.json 'parties', data/encounters.json 'type').
